summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Lumen Runtime. All 12 pytest backend tests PASS (models, sessions, planner events, pause/resume, branch, WebSocket handshake, full run-all pipeline in ~90s, skills list). Frontend workbench flow works end-to-end — landing loads, launch navigates to /runtime/{sid}, autostart triggers pipeline, WebSocket streams live events (51+ events observed), all 5 tabs (plan/knowledge/confidence/skill/replay) render, bottom dock exposes all pipeline buttons + model switcher dropdown, loop inspector shows pause/cancel/inject controls, replay scrubber + event density heatmap visible. Minor React key warnings in EventStream/ReplayScrubber and a Landing default-model mismatch found.

minor.issue: Placing tests under /app/backend/tests triggers uvicorn reload during test runs; combined with background run-all task the shutdown hangs ('Waiting for background tasks to complete'), causing 502s. Mitigation: tests moved to /app/tests/. Recommend excluding tests/ dir from reload watcher or adding graceful task cancellation on shutdown.

ui_bugs.issue: React warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' — events likely mapped without stable key (use ev.id).
Console warnings 'Invalid keyframe value for property filter: blur(-0.0…px)' — an animation interpolates blur into negative values (blur cannot be negative). Clamp min to 0.

Landing.jsx hardcodes default model as 'deepseek/deepseek-chat-v3.1:free' which is NOT in /api/models list (only 'deepseek/deepseek-chat-v3.1' paid variant exists). Backend default is 'openrouter/free'. This causes initial requests to fail with OpenRouter 404 until fallback cascade kicks in (seen in backend logs). Recommendation: default state to the value returned by GET /api/models 'default' field.

issues: Model switcher dropdown overlaps LoopInspector at bottom right when opened on smaller viewports (minor overlap observed in screenshot)

action_items: Fix Landing.jsx default model — set to models.default from GET /api/models (currently hardcoded to non-existent 'deepseek/deepseek-chat-v3.1:free').
Add stable React keys to EventStream and ReplayScrubber list renders (use ev.id).
Clamp Framer Motion blur animation values to >= 0 to eliminate console warnings.

Consider excluding tests/ dir from uvicorn --reload watcher (or handle pipeline background task cancellation in shutdown) — reload during a long-running run-all leaves backend unable to shut down cleanly, producing 502s until manual restart.
critical_code_review_comments: runtime.py:161 — run_all creates a fire-and-forget asyncio.create_task(pipeline()) without tracking; if the process is asked to shut down while pipeline is mid-flight, uvicorn will wait for it. Track it in a set and cancel on shutdown.

server.py:132 — POST /research requires session in memory (returns 404 if only loaded from Mongo). Same for /verify, /skill. This is a UX gap: reload a session id from cold and only /plan works. Consider loading session on demand like /plan does.
runtime.py:190-206 — load_session restores knowledge + plan but not confidence_history or reasoning_tree, so a cold-loaded session loses UI state.
openrouter.py:69 — Fallback cascade retries even on non-retryable errors (e.g., 400 bad request). Should short-circuit on 4xx except 429.
Landing.jsx model select default is decoupled from backend's DEFAULT_MODEL — creates initial 404 storms until cascade succeeds.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — all critical flows work; 3 minor console warnings + 1 default-model bug

test_credentials: No auth — public per-preview URL. OpenRouter key already configured server-side.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 sessions via tests (prefixed TEST_) plus 1 launched via UI ('vision language models for OCR' → sess_bf18c1ea49). Sessions persist in Mongo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tests live at /app/tests/ (NOT /app/backend/tests — that dir triggers uvicorn reload during long pipeline tests and causes 502s). Run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<preview_url> pytest /app/tests/test_lumen_runtime.py -v. Full pipeline test takes ~75s with OpenRouter free models. The 'openrouter/free' meta-router is reliable; other free models sometimes 404/429 and fall through the cascade. WebSocket handshake sends {type:'Connected'} first then buffered events.
rca_of_the_issue: First backend test run failed 100% with 502s. Root cause: pytest test file was placed under /app/backend/tests/, which uvicorn --reload watches. When run-all pipeline test triggered the long-running background asyncio task, any subsequent test file edit caused a reload attempt; uvicorn waited for the background pipeline task to finish (see backend logs: 'Waiting for background tasks to complete') producing a stuck server → Cloudflare 502. Mitigation applied: moved tests to /app/tests/ (outside reload watch); after restart all 12 tests pass in 76s.
